verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page lists "Rich APIs", and community users confirm they can run REST queries and script against the Jira API without the UI. That makes programmatic, non-interactive use possible. However, no evidence shows an official CLI, CI integration docs, or headless/CI usage patterns, and in-product automation rules are a different capability. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline integration (e.g. auth tokens for CI, actions/plugins), in-depth API documentation beyond a feature heading, hands-on corroboration of CI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: the ability to execute useful queries via REST on the data stored in there
I ended up writing some simple Jira API wrapper scripts for submitting bug reports quicker in our systems
